model.title: A resolution recognizing the seriousness of polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and expressing support for the designation of September 2026 as "PCOS Awareness Month".

summary.text: The resolution recognizes polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) as a serious disorder that affects many areas of health, including heart and metabolic health, reproductive health, mental health, and quality of life. It supports designating September 2026 as PCOS Awareness Month, with goals of raising awareness and education about PCOS and related conditions such as type 2 diabetes, endometrial cancer, and heart disease, improving diagnosis and treatment, and better quality of life for women and girls with PCOS. It also calls for more research and better treatment options, urges researchers and health care professionals to improve their understanding of the condition, and encourages states, territories, and localities to support the month's goals.
